scope: Conservative core-stance proposals from original frozen ankle trajectories and weighted sole points. These are starting constraints, not accepted source contact labels or full stance windows.

speed.meaning: Existing controller settings reported by motion lead; not inferred native measurements.

findings: Walk ankles are flat and sweep rearward in listed core ranges.
Walk hind soles remain about 3.8 mm above the fixed ground in core stance. Clearance-only upward correction cannot establish hind contact.
The deepest rising forward Walk toe dip is a swing transition, not a foot to plant.
Source Run has about 19.5 percent all-feet-clear samples at a 5 mm threshold. Preserve those intervals explicitly.
requiredSolverLimits: Smooth circular landing/liftoff envelopes and support switches; no hard edge pinning.
Original poles, measured segment lengths and torso motion preserved.
World support target moves backward locally at one explicit common actor speed.
Independent final-byte same-vertex ground velocity, whole-mesh burial, contact coverage and flight proof; no reliance on these provisional labels for acceptance.
